messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-20260315-9999 fired for hosted-inference (us-west-2) at 2026-03-15T18:02:40Z. Impact: increased 5xx rate. Escalation policy: infra-critical.
Elaine: I'm taking primary. can someone grab recent traces and customer list?
Omar: on it. dashboards show surge in 503s + grpc timeouts on pool-usw2-gpu-b. markers around 18:00 UTC.
Luca: I got the page but my phone forwarded to DND (travel). acked from laptop now. will start triage. :wave:
PagerDuty-bot: Auto-escalation: no primary ack within 3m -> secondary notified (Luca). Next step: manager after 8m if unresolved.
Srinivas: standing by to assist with emergency scaling, not in rotation but available.
Elaine: customer visible: streaming and batch generate endpoints returning 503 intermittently; error spike affects approx 9% of requests across multiple tenants.
Omar: host snapshot:
```
rdwctl host-stats --pool pool-usw2-gpu-b --since 5m
hosts: 8 total
gpu-memory-util: avg 93%
queued-requests: 290 -> 210
kernel-panics: 0
oom-events: 1
```
Looks like two hosts experiencing OOM/kernels evicting KV caches.
Luca: reproducing high tail latency on long-context sequences locally when cache miss rate > 0.8. suspect cold-start eviction combined with autoscaler adding pods.
Marta (manager): Why did PD escalate to manager faster than usual? policy shows primary 3m, secondary 6m, manager 10m. Did we change windows?
PagerDuty-bot: Note: escalation timeline for INC-20260315-9999: primary -> secondary at 3m -> secondary->manager at 8m due to fast-fail setting enabled for infra-critical. Manager page delivered.
Elaine: mitigation proposal: 1) divert new requests to fallback region us-east-1 for gen endpoints, 2) disable long-context routing for pool-usw2-gpu-b, 3) bump pool by +2 hot nodes with warmed caches by forcing pod-prewarm.
Omar: implementing 1 and 3 now. will add prewarm image to new pods and warm common KV keys.
Srinivas: I'll patch ingress policy to reject >64k token requests to this pool temporarily.
Luca: prewarm script output attached to thread: 
```
# prewarm script summary
prewarmed keys: 120k
avg warm time per pod: 14s
```
Traffic shift starting, seeing drop in 503s.
PagerDuty-bot: Activity added to INC-20260315-9999: "regional fallback enabled, pool scaled +2, prewarm executed" by Omar.
Omar: error rate in us-west-2 down from 9% -> 1.1% after scaling+fallback. queue length trending to zero.
Elaine: verifying customer impact: retest with streaming client, successful. marking as mitigated for now.
Marta (manager): Thanks. follow-ups: review fast-fail PD setting (seems to have shortened manager escalation), add mobile-DND guidance for oncall, and ensure prewarm step in autoscaler path.
Luca: agreed. filing three followups: PD policy review, autoscaler prewarm, ingress long-seq throttling.
Srinivas: handing monitoring to night rotation: I'll watch alerts for next 3h. please ping if any blips.
Elaine: creating postmortem doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-20260315-9999-draft. add dashboards and logs.
Omar: attaching debug logs and heap snapshots to the doc.
IncidentBot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" by Elaine. duration ~19m.
Marta (manager): good response. reminder: in next retro, include a short exercise on PD DND scenarios and call-fallback.
Elaine: closing thread for now, will schedule async postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
